name: AI Content Factory
buildTarget: Windows 10 x64; build EXE locally using BUILD-WINDOWS-EXE.bat
features: 13-role AI Workforce: CEO Manager, Trend Researcher, Bible Researcher, Scriptwriter, Theological Guardian, Pastoral Sensitivity, Storyboard Artist, Image Generator, Voice Artist, Video Generator, Video Editor, SEO Publisher, Community / Prayer Manager
Claude API Script Director writes Indonesian narration scripts, hooks, endings, story outlines and 6–8 scene storyboards using JSON Schema structured outputs
Claude storyboard includes reusable character bible, exact ordered narration segments, English Veo prompts, camera movements, moods and 9:16 portrait composition
Ollama Qwen3 4B remains available for local Bible research, theological/pastoral reviews, AI content QC, SEO, and other local Agent functions; optional Groq editorial review remains optional
ElevenLabs is the exclusive Indonesian text-to-speech provider; per-channel Voice IDs, long-narration chunking, MP3-to-WAV conversion and character-level alignment are retained
Actual ElevenLabs character timestamps produce story_timeline.json and absolute scene cut points; proportional fallback is explicitly labelled when matching is insufficient
Google Veo 3.1 Fast/Standard via Vertex AI generates video-only portrait 9:16 clips using ComfyUI-generated character reference images and Google Cloud Storage output
Veo generation uses a single global visual-project lock, serial scene requests, daily estimated-spend guardrail, cumulative clips-per-project cap, usage ledger and stop-on-quota behavior
Google Flow is supported as a manual MP4-per-scene import path; uploaded clips are owner/task-scoped and validated before FFmpeg assembly
Three Guardians remain: Theological Guardian and Pastoral Sensitivity Checker are mandatory pre-publication gates; Community / Prayer Manager creates manual-review comment drafts

Bible Series Generator retains Protestant 66-book canon, 1,189 chapters, episode planning and sequential production; uploaded TB JSON remains local to the Windows Worker and verse text is not synchronized to Firestore/Netlify
ComfyUI + Stable Diffusion 1.5 remains the local image/reference generator; Openverse remains an external asset fallback with attribution/license review
Whisper/faster-whisper local CPU int8 transcription remains available for Indonesian church sermon recordings
FFmpeg renders story videos in 9:16 portrait 720x1280, 30 fps; the standalone Video Editor Studio renders 1080x1920 with voice/music/SRT mixing and under-50MB target
Church Sermon Shorts Editor, original sermon audio retention, timeline clipping, and manual approval remain available
Netlify Dashboard at https://officecontent.netlify.app with authenticated Windows Worker over Tailscale Funnel HTTPS; Worker remains bound to localhost
Firebase Authentication, owner-scoped Firestore metadata, 4 channel profiles, YouTube OAuth, upload ledger, Analytics, reports and workforce synchronization are retained
24/7 scheduler with Sunday 06:00–15:00 WIB rest window, resumable queue, task persistence, QC, upload safety, logs and Windows source/EXE build remain available
release: Claude API Story Director + ElevenLabs character-aligned voice + Google Veo 3.1 9:16 video + Google Flow MP4 import + FFmpeg; all v1.6.4 features retained.
remoteWorkerTunnel: Tailscale Funnel HTTPS (*.ts.net); Worker binds only to 127.0.0.1:8765
